title: Rapport: impact de l'encadrement des loyers à Paris (évaluation 2025)
publisher: APUR / CESAER (Breuillé, Le Gallo et al.)
key_point: Paris rent control cut rents 5-5.2% (2019-24), strongest for studios; 43.2% of listings above cap; no durable supply effect.

title: The Effect of Second-Generation Rent Controls: New Evidence from Catalonia
key_point: Catalan cap cut rents ~5%, rental supply ~15%; above-reference units vanished; heavy non-compliance.

title: All That Glitters? Golden Visas and Real Estate (IZA DP 16857)
key_point: Portugal golden visa: 60% more bunching at EUR500k threshold; price premium over fiscal value ~EUR38-50k.

title: PARIS2019: The impact of rent control on the Parisian rental market
publisher: ERES working paper (Morin, Regnaud, Breuillé, Le Gallo); JHE 2025
key_point: Abstract only: DiD on 422,874 SeLoger listings finds -3.2% rent effect, larger for small flats.

title: PARIS2019: The impact of rent control on the Parisian rental market (Journal of Housing Economics)
key_point: Blocked by anti-bot; snippet: rents down 3.7-4.2% on 559,300 observations, stronger for small apartments.

title: Étude Meilleurs Agents x SeLoger - DPE (communiqué)
key_point: F/G flats 13% cheaper than A/B nationally, but +1.1% dearer in Paris (historic charm); Paris F/G listings +34%.

title: Conjoncture immobilière en Ile-de-France de mars à mai 2026
key_point: Paris apartments EUR9,520/m2 (+0.1% y/y); IdF EUR6,120/m2; Paris volumes -2%; stable but fragile market.

title: Barcelona rent controls nine months into 2025
key_point: Declared rent -2.4% but +2.35%/m2; contracts -9.4%; Idealista asking rents +12% to EUR23.73/m2.

title: Barcelona's rent controls one year on: prices down, access collapsed
key_point: Q1 2025 contracts -23% to record low 7,615; declared rents -8.9%; asking rents +13.6% to EUR23.60/m2.

title: Los expertos alertan: las zonas tensionadas reducen precios, pero se alquilan pisos más pequeños
key_point: Barcelona listings -22.2%, flats 5% smaller (71.4 m2), 462 enquiries per listing vs 103 in Madrid.

title: AMADEI alerta de la tensión residencial en Madrid: más de 200 interesados por cada piso de alquiler
key_point: Madrid: 200+ applicants per rental; landlords require permanent contract, effort <30-35%, insurance, extra guarantees.

title: Quel est l'impact d'un étage sur le prix de vente d'un appartement à Paris ?
key_point: With lift: 6th floor +1.5% vs lower; without lift 6th floor -2.6% vs 2nd; ground floor discounted.

title: Valeur verte: le poids du diagnostic énergétique sur le prix de vente
key_point: Notaires green value: A-B +16%, F-G -12% vs class D, in almost all French metro areas.

title: Propriétaires expatriés : le DPE peut-il faire baisser le prix de votre appartement à Paris ?
key_point: Paris: A-D neutral, E -5%, F -5-10%, G -10-20%; buyers first check Carrez surface, works cost, DPE.

title: Prix immobilier: fiabilité DVF, SeLoger, MeilleursAgents
key_point: Asking 5-8% above sold; DVF 6-month lag, lacks floor/lift/view; estimates within ±5% for ~70% of communes.

title: Demandes de valeurs foncières (DVF)
key_point: Open notarised sale prices, 5 years, updated April/October, excludes Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte, Licence Ouverte 2.0.

title: Diagnostic de performance énergétique (DPE) - location
key_point: G banned from new leases 2025, F 2028, E 2034; F/G rent freeze; 2026 electricity factor 2.3 to 1.9.

title: Garantie VISALE : ce qui change en 2026
key_point: Free guarantee; under-30s any income; IdF rent ceiling EUR1,940 (students EUR1,000); cover limited to 3 years.

title: Encadrement des loyers à Paris : une contrainte plus forte pour certains logements
key_point: 2015-17 scheme: 20% of rents above cap; small-room flats rents -3%, others stable.

title: Zonas tensionadas: qué son, dónde hay y cómo saber si tu vivienda está en una
key_point: 317 tensioned municipalities (Catalonia 271), none in Madrid; caps at previous rent; large landlords use reference index.

title: DPE : selon la note de votre logement, voici de combien sa valeur chute dans ces grandes villes
key_point: F/G apartments in big cities discounted EUR237-667/m2; no Paris-specific figure.

title: Paris preserves its mixed society by pouring billions into public housing (HN discussion)
key_point: 308 participants: Paris middle class squeezed to suburbs; city pre-emption right; social rents 15-20% below market.

title: Portugal proposes to end Golden Visas, curtail Airbnb rentals (HN discussion)
key_point: 182 participants: Lisbon pressure blamed on short-term lets and nomads more than small golden-visa volumes.

title: Spain fines Airbnb EUR65M: why the government is cracking down (HN discussion)
key_point: 89 participants debate tourist lets absorbing central supply vs under-building in Madrid/Barcelona.

title: 2016: 2 ou 3 fois le loyer
key_point: Income of 3x rent is agency/insurer practice, not law; agencies wrongly cite a 'new law'.

title: Achat appartement prix ravalement
key_point: Buyer pricing future façade works; advice: check syndic plans and AG minutes before discounting offer.

title: Barcelona prices per square metre (forum)
key_point: Barcelona m2 usually usable not built; Idealista asking vs tasación data; new-build vs resale distinction.

title: Impact of rent control in Paris (2023)
key_point: Average rent EUR1,469 vs EUR1,533 counterfactual (EUR64/month saving); moderation 2.5% (2020) to 5.9% (2023).

title: Paris : ces arrondissements où les prix ont (vraiment) augmenté en 2026
key_point: 403; snippet: 6e >EUR14,000/m2 vs 19e <EUR7,500-8,200; ~1.9% average annual rise.

title: Erreur de superficie : pouvez-vous exiger une baisse du prix ?
key_point: 403; snippet: Carrez error >5% gives proportional price cut, action within one year, buyer bears proof.

title: Mercato immobiliare Milano
key_point: 403; Milan not covered in this stream.
